title: fix: add OpenRouter fallback for GLM 5.3 Flash
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a hidden shared fallback for `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` when Fireworks is throttled or fails. Fireworks remains primary (`accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash`).
- Routes OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` across Together, Baseten, Modal, Crusoe, Friendli, DigitalOcean, Parasail, and Venice with provider failover enabled. Excludes Fireworks and Z.ai: Z.ai ignored the JSON schema in a live probe.
- Preserves the public ID, no aliases, multiplier 1, Quest access (`paidOnly: false`), and existing user quote. These are provider APIs, not Pollinations GPUs. Records fallback costs at $0.15 input / $0.03 cached / $0.50 output per million tokens plus the 5.5% OpenRouter credit fee; Pollinations absorbs the difference. [Exact endpoint pricing](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash/endpoints).
- Validation: 155 Worker tests, typecheck, Biome; live forced fallback through Chat Completions, native text, Messages, and Responses. Covers streaming, tools, vision, JSON schema, small output limits, default reasoning, output-cache HIT, and a four-request burst. A 940,016-token direct prompt passed. Staging Tinybird usage/cost/attribution matches the response and one wallet debit.
- Provider prompt-cache probes reported zero cached tokens. Production rollout remains pending.

gist.headline: A second path for GLM
gist.blurb: GLM 5.3 Flash gets a backup route when Fireworks needs a breather. Same model name, less dependence on one provider having a good day.
gist.summary: Added a hidden OpenRouter fallback for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash when its primary Fireworks provider is throttled or fails, with failover across eight providers while preserving the public model ID and Quest access.
gist.impact: Requests for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash can continue through the same model ID when Fireworks is unavailable, including requests that use streaming, tools, vision, or JSON schema.
gist.visual_concept: In a cozy code garden, Polli tends a GLM 5.3 Flash flower connected to a primary Fireworks path and a branching OpenRouter backup path. A small JSON schema page beside the flower hints that structured output matters on either route.
